name: Studio Voltaire
watch: Bloomberg Philanthropies supported its website through the Digital Accelerator Programme. 260 UK artists asked five London theatres to drop Bloomberg in May 2026.

name: Auto Italia South East
watch: Artist-run organisation. It began in a Peckham car showroom.

name: Transmission Gallery
watch: Artist-run cooperative founded in 1983 by Glasgow School of Art graduates as an alternative to commercial galleries. Run by an unpaid artist committee in rotation.

name: Secession (Wiener Secession)
watch: The world's oldest independent artist-run exhibition house, founded 1897 by Gustav Klimt and fellow Secessionists. Motto: 'To every age its art, to art its freedom'.

name: SOMA
watch: Counter-institutional space founded in 2009 by a collective of artists led by Yoshua Okón.

name: Khoj International Artists' Association
watch: Benefactor Sangeeta Jindal (JSW Foundation): JSW is mostly steel; its power arm is about 5% of group revenue (US$1.1B of US$23B).
